svg.aria-label: An experiment on the left shines a spotlight across into a circle, the whole system, whose near edge is the visible service. The light reaches the far side. In it, interpretation, legislation, operations, decision rights and relationships, each joined to the others by a fine line, with more dotted connections showing wherever they cross the light. The rest of the circle is hatched and labelled dark matter, and nothing in it can be seen.
svg.title: The whole system as a circle, its near edge the visible service. A spotlight shines from an experiment through it to the far side, and five materials and the relationships between them come into view, with more connections showing where they cross the light. Hatching covers the rest, the service's dark matter, where whatever else there is stays hidden
